services.desc: Looking for a high-adrenaline, offshore fishing experience? ‍Step aboard Way OverBoard Sport Fishing for one of the most thrilling trips on the water - tuna fishing off the Jersey Shore. services.name: All Cruises
services.desc: There's nothing quite like watching the sun set over the water. Our sunset cruises are a relaxed, scenic way to spend an evening - no fishing required. Just sit back, enjoy the ride, and take in the coastline as the sky changes color over Belmar and the Jersey Shore. We depart from Belmar, NJ and cruise along the coast, timed to catch golden hour and sunset over the water. It's a popular choice for date nights, small celebrations, and anyone who wants a memorable evening on the water without the demands of fishing or running the boat. Cruise length and timing shift with the season to make sure you catch the best light. Reach out to check availability and lock in your date. Way Overboard

services.name: Wildlife Cruises
services.desc: Way Overboard Sportfishing offers private wildlife cruises out of Belmar, NJ, giving your group the chance to spot humpback whales, dolphins, sea turtles, and other marine life along the Jersey Shore. Unlike the large narrated tour boats that run out of Belmar Marina, our wildlife cruises are private - it's just your group aboard our 32' Regulator FS, with Capt. Chris at the helm. The waters off Belmar, Manasquan, and the greater Jersey Shore are part of a rich feeding ground for humpback whales, especially from late spring through fall.
